description: This Java class 'ConfiguredFilter' defines a filter for Android logcat messages, including pattern matching for message, tag, package name, process ID, and log level, with methods for compilation and applicability checking.

classes.name: ConfiguredFilter
classes.description: A class representing a logcat filter with pattern matching and applicability logic.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if a log message with given parameters matches the filter criteria.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Creates a ConfiguredFilter instance from a filter entry and name, compiling patterns.

methods.name: compilePattern
methods.description: Compiles a regex pattern string into a Pattern object with specific flags.
